verses.text: I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
lines: I will extol you, Yahweh, for you have raised me up,
and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.

verses.text: Yahweh my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.
lines: Yahweh my God, I cried to you,
and you have healed me.

verses.text: Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
lines: Yahweh, you have brought up my soul from Sheol.
You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

verses.text: Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.
lines: Sing praise to Yahweh, you saints of his.
Give thanks to his holy name.

verses.text: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
lines: For his anger is but for a moment.
His favor is for a lifetime.
Weeping may stay for the night,
but joy comes in the morning.

verses.text: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”
lines: As for me, I said in my prosperity,
“I shall never be moved.”

verses.text: You, Yahweh, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.
lines: You, Yahweh, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong;
but when you hid your face, I was troubled.

verses.text: I cried to you, Yahweh. I made supplication to the Lord:
lines: I cried to you, Yahweh.
I made supplication to the Lord:

verses.text: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?
lines: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit?
Shall the dust praise you?
Shall it declare your truth?

verses.text: Hear, Yahweh, and have mercy on me. Yahweh, be my helper.”
lines: Hear, Yahweh, and have mercy on me.
Yahweh, be my helper.”

verses.text: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,
lines: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me.
You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,

verses.text: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
lines: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent.
Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
